name: @stonkz/curve-sim
description: Workspace-importable copy of programs/curve-sim.ts (the TS mirror of the on-chain bonding curve). apps/api's quote and trade composition import this package rather than reimplementing curve math. test/sync.test.ts fails the build the moment this file and programs/curve-sim.ts diverge, so drift is a loud CI failure rather than a silent quote/fill mismatch.
